items.concept: Indian place value system up to ten-thousands and beyond
items.explanation: Learners develop Indian place value system up to ten-thousands and beyond. The idea should be represented, discussed, practised and then applied in a new context.
key_questions: What does Indian place value system up to ten-thousands and beyond mean?
How can you represent or check it?
Where could you use it outside this exercise?
items.misconception_risk: Confusing the representation or unit with the quantity itself; always check using an equivalent representation.

Where could you use it outside this exercise?
items.misconception_risk: Confusing the representation or unit with the quantity itself; always check using an equivalent representation.

key_rules: 1 ten = 10 ones; 1 hundred = 10 tens; 1 thousand = 10 hundreds; 1 ten-thousand = 10 thousands.
For constant speed, distance = speed × time.
For rounding, inspect the digit immediately to the right of the place being rounded.
